page_note: 这是一页Activate Consulting的报告幻灯片，含一张按地区拆分的堆叠柱状图，展示2019/2021/2025E/2029E全球消费者游戏收入（美国与世界其他地区）及各段CAGR圆形标注。

heading.title: CONSUMER VIDEO GAME REVENUE BY REGION¹, GLOBAL, 2019 VS. 2021 VS. 2025E VS. 2029E, BILLIONS USD

figures.source_line: Sources: Activate analysis, Newzoo, Omdia, PricewaterhouseCoopers, Statista
Sources: Activate analysis, Newzoo, Omdia, PricewaterhouseCoopers, Statista

components.evidence: each bar splits into a dark lower segment ($35B) and a light upper segment ($101B), total $136B
only a horizontal baseline under the bars; no value ticks anywhere, values only as printed labels
"$101B", "$35B", "$121B", "$48B" printed in white inside the segments
totals "$136B", "$169B", "$180B", "$214B" printed in black above each bar
black circles "11%", "2%", "4%" and purple circles "10%", "16%", "2%", "1%", "4%" over inter-bar gaps
arrow boxes at right edge label "REST OF WORLD" and "U.S." pointing at the 2029E segments
globe pictogram in the REST OF WORLD box, U.S. map pictogram in the U.S. box
"BY REGION¹" superscript 1 with note "1. Excludes hardware and device sales..."
"1. Excludes hardware and device sales, augmented/virtual reality content, and advertising." plus "Sources: Activate analysis, Newzoo..."
banner heading ends "BILLIONS USD"; no axis carries the scale
year labels "2019", "2021", "2025E", "2029E" under baseline; double-slash break glyphs also sit on the baseline

new_components.name: gap_annotation_between_bars
new_components.evidence: CAGR circles "11%","10%","16%" sit on a grey vertical band between the 2019 and 2021 bars
new_components.why_it_matters: 这些百分数不是柱体高度，而是相邻两柱之间的增长率标注，读值时必须按“起止年份对+系列”寻址，否则会被误当作某柱的数值。

new_components.name: axis_break_glyph_on_category_axis
new_components.evidence: double-slash marks drawn on the horizontal baseline between adjacent year bars
new_components.why_it_matters: none不截断而非数值轴截断，说明时间轴跳过2020、2022-2024，读者不能按等距年份插值。（时间不连续）

new_components.name: forecast_badge
new_components.evidence: "ACTIVATE FORECAST" logo badge placed inside the plot area top-left
new_components.why_it_matters: 标明整图（含2025E/2029E）为预测数据，读值时需区分实际值与预测值。

difficulty_notes: 所有数值都以标签印在图上（$101B…$59B、10%/16%），且没有数值轴，所以第2步（读像素）几乎不成问题；难点在寻址。同一图里混着两类量纲：8个柱段是十亿美元，另外8个圆圈是CAGR百分比，且百分比的行标签（U.S./REST OF WORLD）只由箭头框在右侧给出、列标签是“2019-2021 CAGR:”这种跨列区间。要唯一定位“16”需要三个键（2019-2021、CAGR、U.S.），而黑色总CAGR圆（11%/2%/4%）与紫色分区圆共享同一列名，解析出的表格若不区分系列维度，4%会出现三次而无法辨别。
